findings.text: non-blocking: the receipt-atomicity claim has no negative control - no test makes the receipt write fail and asserts the move rolled back, so reverting the block to the two autocommit queries it replaced leaves every test green and the defect the prior review found would return silently.

non-blocking: the unconditional drained receipt is unguarded - every test drives retarget_standard_name_sources with record_change defaulting true, while all four production callers at edit.py:1944, graph_refinement.py:1329, graph_supersession.py:4139 and provenance_lifecycle.py:2228 pass false, so reinstating the removed guard reddens nothing.

non-blocking: the non-GraphClient branch writes the receipt in a second autocommit statement with no warning, so any duck-typed client passed through services silently loses the atomicity the docstring at graph_source_bindings.py:1633 now promises.
